items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: He used to come by the house and get me... he used to have their music there... Boots used to like to gamble, so he'd come get me and set me down... I played a couple of hours or so for it.

ctx.x: Who were your favorite trombone players when you were young? Any, aside from the people you studied with, you must have liked them when you wouldn't

have studied? Well, as a fellow, there's something else I forgot to tell you too. I think he was a great trombone player, but people never talked about him. He was smooth, and he was a fellow who gave me an idea of, you know, peeing up on your ground and playing melody too, was Boots.
